name: Screen-Space God Rays
definition: A screen-space post-processing technique that fakes volumetric light shafts using a radial blur on an occlusion map, dominating implementations for over a decade due to speed and simplicity.
summary: Screen-Space God Rays is a fast post-processing technique that fakes volumetric light shafts using radial blur on an occlusion map, offering speed over accuracy for single visible lights.
